verdict.rationale: Rev AI publishes a pricing page with at least one per-minute rate (Whisper Large transcription at $0.005 per minute), and its free-credit allowance is expressed in hours of Reverb ASR. An agent could therefore estimate base cost from audio duration for that model, though the pack shows only a single SKU price. Missing for 10: per-minute prices for other models (Reverb ASR, human transcription), itemized prices for add-ons (summarization, translation, sentiment, topic extraction, language ID), and any machine-readable or independently corroborated pricing source.
